registered_fault_end_events.semantics: Observed registered exogenous fault boundary, not repair or actual output

execution_recovery.first_P0_and_sustained_service_recovery: Use the unchanged existing service metrics, not this diagnostic

definitions.connection: original demand = connected + physically disconnected; connected unmet = total unmet - disconnected
definitions.service: Original classifier/19 targets unchanged; added material-duration statistics are descriptive
definitions.startup: Requested, completion event and actual positive output are separately counted
definitions.recovery: 30 continuous clean observed minutes is descriptive, not a clinical threshold
definitions.long_windows: Separate named windows, never pooled with original full600 or incident counts
definitions.registered_full: Actual requested [0,end), distinct from legacy full600 and long1440
definitions.event_windows: Named episode-clock intervals; no relabeling of original nineteen scores
definitions.P3: Cold ENS measured; disturbed room temperature is null unless a separately declared model supplies it

event_order_migration.ordering_basis: Explicit original native core:N numeric sequence within identical recorded minute only

P3.meaning: Original P3 false flag is not evidence of temperature safety; evaluate actual P3 cold service separately

diesel_local_response.units: kWh; mechanical/rotor accounting is an explicit research fuel-budget migration, not physical liters
diesel_local_response.energy_identity: mechanical work = electrical work + declared losses + rotor energy change

episode_audit.heat_check: Recorded steam/equivalent equality plus independently recomputed source adequacy; unused-steam variable not saved
